verdict.rationale: Luma's own API FAQ states directly that there is no staging or sandbox environment. A named 'test key' is still a production key that shares quota with other keys, and there is no free tier. Draft Mode, test keys and small generations are user-side workarounds for testing against production, not an isolated sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
